title: A distributed-delay model for the El Niño Southern Oscillation with a minimum delay: a case study of the shifted linear chain trick
summary: When modelling a system of interest with a delay differential equation, a distributed delay may be the appropriate modelling choice when the delayed response occurs over a significant range of times rather than with a single constant delay. In systems with a minimum physical transit or processing time, however, the delay kernel should respect a fixed and positive minimum delay.
